Shankland at the double as Rangers win at Falkirk
items.description: Lawrence Shankland's stunning double secured back-to-back Scottish Premiership wins for Rangers with a 2-1 victory at Falkirk on Wednesday night.

items.title: Duran nets again as Celtic maintain perfect start with win over Aberdeen
items.description: Camilo Duran scored another stunner as Celtic continued their perfect start to the Scottish Premiership season with a 3-0 win over Aberdeen.

items.title: Wrexham earn first win of the season at Millwall
items.description: Wrexham got their first win of the Championship season in style as Millwall were swept aside 3-0 at the New Den.

items.title: Burnley battle back to hold Middlesbrough
items.description: Ugo Raghouber's first goal for Burnley earned only their second point from their opening four Championship matches as they came from behind to draw 1-1 with Middlesbrough.

items.title: Burrell double steers QPR to victory
items.description: Rumarn Burrell scored both QPR goals as they beat Cardiff 2-1 at Loftus Road to continue their impressive start to the Championship season.

items.title: Charlton hit back to hold West Brom
items.description: Charlton's 100 per cent record was brought to and end but they remain unbeaten as Tyreece Campbell's second-half strike earned a 1-1 draw against West Brom.

items.title: Aasgaard makes Anderlecht switch as Rangers reject Raskin bid
items.description: Rangers midfielder Thelo Aasgaard is on the verge of a loan move to Anderlecht, while the Ibrox club have knocked back an loan bid from Besiktas for Belgium midfielder Nicolas Raskin.
